task_title: Cache received published content in SQLite for offline use
result: PASS — offline cache schema, adapter, read-through store and tests all pass.
user_visible_outcome: No screen change. Published content received from the read API is now written to SQLite and served from it when the network is unavailable or the backend is unconfigured. A failed or absent remote never crashes a read; it returns cached rows or an honest empty result.
files_changed: apps/mobile/src/infrastructure/sqlite/publishedContentCache.ts (new: SQLite cache adapter, replace-per-scope in a transaction)
apps/mobile/src/content/publishedContentStore.ts (remote-first + write-through cache + offline fallback; initializePublishedContentCache; publishedContentLastSyncedAt)
apps/mobile/app/_layout.tsx (instantiate the cache from the DB handle; inject into the store)
apps/mobile/__tests__/published-content-cache.test.ts (new: adapter replace/read round-trips, scope filtering, last-sync)

design.schema: Migration 008 adds published_verses_cache, published_entities_cache, published_attestations_cache and published_cache_meta. Strict CHECKs mirror the published read API (sha256 text hashes, positive chapter, published review_state is a copied field, not re-validated locally).
design.strategy: Read-through cache. On a configured remote the store fetches from Supabase first and writes the result through to SQLite (replace-per-scope inside one transaction, so an empty published slice clears stale rows). If the remote is unconfigured or fails, the store reads the cache; if neither has content it returns []. Reads never throw.
design.layering: Screens never touch SQLite or Supabase; the cache implements a content-layer port and is injected at the composition root, matching the existing passage/bookmark/progress repositories.
design.sign_out: The published cache is public server content, not user data, so sign-out does not wipe it (library wipe is unchanged).

tests.cache_adapter: Replace-per-scope DELETE + INSERT OR REPLACE with exact params; verse/entity/attestation read mapping; attestation scope filter; lastSyncedAt returns the stamp or null.
tests.store: Writes received rows through to the cache and stamps last-synced; falls back to cached rows when the remote throws; reads the cache when no remote is configured; returns [] (no throw) when neither source has content.
tests.migrations: Registry is versions 1-8 with names recorded and a verified no-op on re-run.

known_limitations: Nothing is published yet, so a live sync currently caches an empty slice; the path is exercised by tests and will populate once a publication release exists.
No cache eviction/TTL: a scope is replaced only when that scope is fetched again; lastSyncedAt is exposed for a future freshness policy.
The cached content is not yet consumed by a screen (screens keep reading bundled/SQLite Scripture); the store API is ready for that wiring.
stop_condition: Stopped after the published content is cached in SQLite with offline fallback and proven by tests. No publication, no screen redesign, no new dependency.
